mission.evidence: One cheap discriminator removes a route-level unknown but does not itself produce hypothesis evidence or cashflow.

flexibility.evidence: The classifier owns Solana response semantics while provider transport remains replaceable; exact target and window prevent accidental generic-platform scope.

compatibility_and_history.evidence: The A15P exact timestamps and NO_OBSERVATION_UNKNOWN truth are preserved without rewriting earlier receipts.

efficiency.evidence: One proposed one-credit request is cheaper and faster than another blind ten-minute WSS capture.

research_truth.evidence: Acknowledgement/boundary, null, short non-bracketing history, truncation, malformed and ordering cases stay typed UNKNOWN; provider completeness is not assumed and absence is never converted into volume zero or pool inactivity.

owner_operability_and_ux.evidence: The owner has one exact future phrase and one decision-changing question, with no developer choice required.

execution_to_cashflow.evidence: This is a data-route diagnostic before strategy or execution authority.

monitoring_and_recovery.evidence: The future proposal is foreground-only, one-shot, no retry/fallback and retains raw evidence under A4.

build_vs_buy.evidence: WRAP uses standard Solana getSignaturesForAddress and existing Helius conventions; no collector, scheduler or new dependency was built.

red_team.evidence: Tests attack type confusion, extra fields, wrong identity, TransactionError shape, duplicates, slot ordering/ties, acknowledgement and terminal boundary seconds, short history, truncation and RPC errors.

limitations: No external response has been captured under this contract.
A matching signature proves address activity, not a PumpSwap trade or market observation.
Post-ack address activity selects route review but does not alone prove a WSS delivery defect.
A short or empty non-bracketing page cannot support a negative conclusion.
A full 1000-record page may require redesign; pagination is outside A16 authority.

now.value: Choose between WSS route repair and target inactivity without another blind waiting window.
now.evidence: A15P accepted the subscription but observed zero notifications in 600 seconds.
now.cost_risk: One separately authorized Helius read, one estimated credit and one A4 raw object.
now.activation_trigger: Offline A16 PR is delivered and the owner supplies the exact runtime phrase.
now.why: It is the smallest observation that changes the next technical route.

watch.value: Determine whether a proved address signature is a PumpSwap trade relevant to H07/H01.
watch.evidence: Only needed if A16 observes interior address activity and that distinction changes the experiment.
watch.cost_risk: Additional RPC, decoding and research-truth scope; may still not yield a panel.
watch.why: Do not decode transactions before activity exists.
